about: Sunil Singhania is an Indian fund manager and the founder of Abakkus Asset Manager. He set it up in 2018 after leaving Reliance Mutual Fund, where he was chief investment officer for equities. His listed bets are made through Abakkus funds, and Abakkus Asset Manager filed draft papers with SEBI for its own IPO in September 2026.

faq: What is Sunil Singhania's portfolio worth?
The Abakkus funds' disclosed holdings were about ₹2,219 crore across roughly 35 stocks after the September 2026 filings, per Trendlyne.
What did Sunil Singhania buy recently?

Abakkus funds bought 11 lakh Jubilant Pharmova shares at ₹915 on 12 October 2026 and about 11 lakh AXISCADES shares at ₹1,824 on 29 September 2026. New stakes in the September quarter include Dhabriya Polywood, Sejal Glass, Adroit Industries and Paramount Communications.
How is the Dhabriya Polywood bet doing?
Abakkus bought 6,01,341 shares at ₹387.04 on 23 July 2026. At about ₹481 in November 2026, that was up roughly 24% on paper.
How do you know the prices?
Prices are exact only for bulk and block deals, which the exchanges publish daily. Quarterly filings show shares held but not the price paid, so those gains are shown as not public or estimated.
